div.head: Ger 10
div.ab: [10] on hærfeste ripan, in Agusto 7 Septembri 7 Octobri mawan, wad spittan, fela tilða ham gæderian, ðacian, ðecgan 7 fald weoxian, scipena behweorfan 7 hlosan eac swa, ær to tune to stið winter cume, 7 eac yrðe georne forðian;

On hærfeste . ripan in agusto . 7 septembri. 7 octobri . mawan wad spittan. fela til||ða ham gæderian . ðacian . ðecgan .7 fald weoxian scipena behweorfan . 7 hlosan eac swa . ær to tune to stið winter cume . 7 eac yr | ðe georne forðian.

During autumn reap [fields] in August and September and October, mow [pasture], plant woad, gather cultivated products in to the home, thatch the thatch-roof, and to clean the fold and prepare the cattle-shed, and likewise the pigsty, before the harshness of winter comes to the estate, and also to go forth and to plough diligently.

im Herbste ernten, im August und September und October mähen, Waid [mit dem Rundspaten] abstechen, viele Bodenerträge heimsammeln, Dach machen, decken und Hürde reinigen, Ställe herrichten und Verschläge für Kleinvieh[?] ebenfalls — bevor ins Land zu harter Winter kommt — und auch das Pflügen eifrig vollführen;

at harvest reap, in August and September and October mow, cut woad [with the round spade], gather home many crops, thatch and cover, and clean the fold, prepare cattle-sheds and pens for small stock[?] likewise — before too hard a winter comes to the estate — and also eagerly carry out the ploughing;
div.note: ‘weoxian’ = ‘wischen’, to clean (Pogatscher: ‘wicker’, weave). Liebermann compares Gerefa 13 and 15, Rect 7.
